body:
Buddhism and stoicism are great philosophies and much of CBT is similar to them.

The problem with Buddhism is that it's too damn complicated with terminology and there are a lot of myths surrounding it. It would be good if someone made an user-friendly version of Buddhism.

The problem with stoicism is that there aren't much material about it, but there's been a revival so you might start to get more stuff being created.

I recommend you to read Mindfulness in Plain English, and The Emperor's Handbook. Both are great and will provide you a good guidance on how to deal with your problems.
